# Code of Conduct

We are committed to a welcoming, respectful community. Treat people with patience and respect, give constructive feedback, and focus discussion on the work.

Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, threats, and publication of another person's private information are not acceptable. Maintainers may edit or remove harmful content and restrict participation when needed to protect the community.

Report conduct concerns privately to the repository maintainers at <https://github.com/casjay>.
